page.description: SteamOS recovery image for Steam Deck: size, architecture and a SHA-256 computed by ROMinit.
page.eyebrow: OPERATING SYSTEM / STEAM DECK RECOVERY IMAGE
page.intro: Valve's SteamOS image for the Steam Deck, published as a recovery image rather than a generic installer. It restores a Deck; it is not a PC installer for other machines.
pros: Valve's own image for restoring or reinstalling SteamOS on a Steam Deck.
Includes the recovery tools and a re-image flow for the internal drive.
Published as one x86_64 image for the Deck hardware.
SteamOS is Arch-based and rolls with Steam client updates.
cons: Not a general-purpose PC installer: it targets Steam Deck hardware.
Valve publishes no SHA-256, so the hash here is computed by ROMinit.
The image date is Valve's file date (2022-05-15); Valve publishes no release date.
Writing the image erases the target drive.
page.previewNote: A stock screenshot of KDE Plasma on a Steam Deck desktop from Wikimedia Commons. It is not the recovery image and not a ROMinit recording: no image was written and nothing was booted for this page.

shot.caption: Stock screenshot of KDE Plasma on Steam Deck · no image written, no boot tested.

page.status: One image: Valve's Steam Deck recovery image, written to a USB stick and used to restore the Deck's internal drive. Writing erases the stick and the re-image step erases the Deck. Its SHA-256 was computed by ROMinit from Valve's official download on 2026-10-27, not published by Valve.
